' '--- go.mod ---' && cat go.mod && printf '%s
' '--- alphametics_test.go ---' && cat alphametics_test.go && printf '%s
' '--- cases_test.go ---' && cat cases_test.go

cd /exercise && python3 - <<'PY'
import re
s=open('cases_test.go').read()
m=re.search(r'input:\s+"(THIS [^"]*FORTRESSES)"',s)
p=m.group(1)
left,right=p.split('==')
words=[w.strip() for w in left.split('+')]
result=right.strip()
print('addends',len(words),'result',result,'maxlen',max(map(len,words)),len(result))
maxlen=max(max(map(len,words)),len(result))
cols=[]
for j in range(maxlen):
    cnt={}
    for w in words:
        if j < len(w):
            c=w[-1-j]
            cnt[c]=cnt.get(c,0)+1
    r=result[-1-j] if j < len(result) else None
    cols.append((j,cnt,r))
seen=set()
for j,cnt,r in cols:
    letters=set(cnt)
    if r: letters.add(r)
    print(j, 'terms',sum(cnt.values()),'distinct',len(letters),'new',sorted(letters-seen),'counts',dict(sorted(cnt.items())),'res',r)
    seen|=letters
